title: Interaction of Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances with Estrogen Receptors in Rainbow Trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss): An In Silico Investigation.
authors: Bali, Semiha Kevser; Hall, Kyleen; Massoud, Rana I; Almeida, Nuno M S; Wilson, Angela K
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子动力学模拟和结合自由能计算考察PFAS与虹鳟雌激素受体的结合，虽属蛋白-配体互作而非蛋白-DNA体系，且无AI或TF-DNA结合建模，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: Fresh water sources, including lakes, such as the Great Lakes, are some of the most important ecosystems in the world. Despite the importance of these lakes, there is increasing concern about the presence of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) horizontal line among the most prevalent contaminants of our time horizontal line due to the ability of PFAS to bioaccumulate and persist in the environment, as well as to its linkages to detrimental human and animal health effects. In this study, PFAS exposure on rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) is examined at the molecular level, focusing on the impact of PFAS binding on the alpha (alpha) and beta (beta) estrogen receptors (ERs) using molecular dynamics simulations, binding free energy calculations, and structural analysis. ERs are involved in fundamental physiological processes, including reproductive system development, muscle regeneration, and immunity. This study shows that PFAS binds to both the estrogen alpha and estrogen beta receptors, albeit via different binding modes, due to a modification of an amino acid in the binding site as a result of a reorientation of residues in the binding pocket. As ER overactivation can occur through environmental toxins and pollutants, this study provides insights into the influence of different types of PFAS on protein function.
abstract_zh: 淡水资源，包括像五大湖这样的湖泊，是世界上最重要的生态系统之一。尽管这些湖泊的重要性不言而喻，但人们越来越关注全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）的存在，这些物质是当代最普遍的污染物之一，因为PFAS具有生物累积性和环境持久性，并且与对人类和动物健康的有害影响相关联。在本研究中，从分子水平上考察了PFAS暴露对虹鳟鱼（Oncorhynchus mykiss）的影响，重点通过分子动力学模拟、结合自由能计算和结构分析，研究PFAS结合对α（alpha）和β（beta）雌激素受体（ERs）的影响。雌激素受体参与基本生理过程，包括生殖系统发育、肌肉再生和免疫。本研究表明，PFAS与雌激素α和雌激素β受体均结合，尽管通过不同的结合模式，这是由于结合位点中一个氨基酸的修饰，源于结合口袋中残基的重新定向。由于环境毒素和污染物可能导致雌激素受体过度激活，本研究为不同类型PFAS对蛋白质功能的影响提供了见解。
